inlines.v: WAVY, adjective [from wave.[ 1. Rising or swelling in waves; full of waves; as the wavy sea. 2. Playing to and fro; undulating. Let her glad valleys smile with wavy corn. 3. Undulating on the border or on the surface; a botanical use. Wawes or waes, for waves. [Not in use.]
